Application Data.NAME: Glassworks Solutions, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Glassworks Solutions, LLC specializes in the installation, repair, and maintenance of residential and commercial glass and window products. Our services include custom fabrications, energy-efficient window installations, and emergency glass replacement. We operate within a 100-mile radius from our headquarters in Springfield, IL, ensuring adherence to transit coverage guidelines. Our team is trained in safety protocols and uses certified domestic manufacturers for all laminated glass sourcing to comply with ASTM International standards. We prioritize quality workmanship and customer satisfaction while maintaining strict safety measures to mitigate risks associated with property damage and employee safety during installations.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/22/2022, a minor accident occurred during transport, resulting in $2,000 of damage to a client's property due to a dropped glass pane. The incident was resolved without a claim, and the client appreciated our prompt communication and repairs. On 08/15/2021, we faced $10,500 in losses from a breakage incident during window installation, which was claimed and fully paid. The claim is now closed. Total losses amount to $12,500; all incidents have been documented and managed within our safety protocols.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and 24-hour surveillance monitoring system in place.
